import numpy as np, itertools
WE=W['W_E']; WP=W['W_pos']; WU=W['W_U']
A0=(W['L0.W_Q'][0]@W['L0.W_K'][0].T)/np.sqrt(8); P0=W['L0.W_V'][0]@W['L0.W_O'][0]
A1=(W['L1.W_Q'][0]@W['L1.W_K'][0].T)/np.sqrt(8); P1=W['L1.W_V'][0]@W['L1.W_O'][0]
Xall=np.array(list(itertools.product(range(6),repeat=6)))
def fwd(x):
    E=WE[x]+WP[None,:,:]
    s0=np.einsum('bpd,bjd->bpj',E@A0,E); a0=np.exp(s0-s0.max(2,keepdims=True)); a0/=a0.sum(2,keepdims=True)
    r0=E+np.einsum('bpj,bjd->bd',a0,E@P0)
    q1=r0[:,5]@A1; s1=np.einsum('bd,bjd->bj',q1,r0)
    a1=np.exp(s1-s1.max(1,keepdims=True)); a1/=a1.sum(1,keepdims=True)
    o1=np.einsum('bj,bjd->bd',a1,r0@P1); r1=r0[:,5]+o1
    return dict(E=E,a0=a0,r0=r0,a1=a1,o1=o1,r1=r1,out=r1@WU)
F=fwd(Xall)
print('check', np.abs(F['out']-run(Xall)).max())
dec=F['out'].argmax(1)
print(np.bincount(dec))
# class 3
c3=Xall[dec==3]
print('n3',len(c3)); print(c3[:20])
print('class3 logits sample'); print(np.round(F['out'][dec==3][:8],2))
print('x5 in class3', np.bincount(c3[:,5],minlength=6))

    n=len(x); F=[]
    cntv=np.stack([(x==x[:,p][:,None]).sum(1) for p in range(6)],1).astype(float)
    fix=(x==np.arange(6)[None,:]).astype(float)
    two=np.stack([(x[np.arange(n),x[:,p]]==p).astype(float) for p in range(6)],1)
    F=[fix,cntv,two,np.eye(6)[x[:,5]],np.eye(6)[x[:,0]],(fix*cntv)]
    return np.concatenate(F,1)

```python
import numpy as np
DESCRIPTION=("Read x as a map f on 6 points, f(p)=x[p]. Layer 0 lets every position find the points that map "
 "to it, so the residual carries, per position p, whether p is a fixed point and how many preimages its "
 "value has; layer 1 sums that census and the readout scores three structural classes. Census cells "
 "(shares measured on all 6^6 inputs): a 2-cycle -> class 1 (97%); else at least two fixed points (95%) or "
 "a fixed point whose value has two or more preimages (84-99%) -> class 0; a lone fixed point (77%) or no "
 "fixed point (91%) -> class 2. Class 3 is a near tie with class 2 and is not reproduced.")
def model(x,iv):
    h=np.arange(6.)
    tok=[iv("tok%d"%p,(x[:,p][:,None]==h).astype(float)) for p in range(6)]
    T=np.stack([t@h for t in tok],1).astype(int)      # token at each position
    fix=(T==np.arange(6)).astype(float)               # p is a fixed point
    cnt=np.stack([(T==j).sum(1) for j in range(6)],1) # preimages of value j
    pre=np.take_along_axis(cnt,T,1)                   # preimages of the value at p
    cyc=(np.take_along_axis(T,T,1)==np.arange(6)).astype(float)  # p lies on a 2-cycle
    fp=iv("fp",fix.sum(1))
    t2=iv("t2",cyc.sum(1)/2)
    nP=iv("nP",(fix*pre).max(1))                      # max preimage count of a fixed value
    h1=t2>0; h0=fp>0; lo=(fp==1)&(nP<1.5)&~h1
    s0=(~h1)*(4.0*h0*(~lo)+2.0*fp)
    s1=6.0*h1+2.0*t2
    s2=(~h1)*(3.0*(~h0)+5.0*lo)
    z=np.zeros(len(x))
    return np.stack([s0,s1,s2,z,z-1,z-2],1)
ALIGN={"tok%d"%p:["embed"] for p in range(6)}
```

import numpy as np
DESCRIPTION=("Read x as a map f on 6 points, f(p)=x[p]. Layer 0 moves, into each position, the points that map onto "
 "it, so a position's residual carries how many preimages its value has; layer 1 iterates that relation and the "
 "readout scores the cycle structure of the map. Measured on all 6^6 inputs: a 2-cycle anywhere -> class 1 (98%); "
 "otherwise a fixed point with no cycle of length >=3 -> class 0 (95%); otherwise (a fixed point together with a "
 "long cycle, or no fixed point at all) -> class 2 (66% / 91%). Class 3 is a near-tie with class 2 (logit margin "
 "~0.1) and is not reproduced.")
def model(x,iv):
    h=np.arange(6.)
    A=np.stack([iv("tok%d"%p,(x[:,p][:,None]==h).astype(float)) for p in range(6)],1)
    d=[]; Ak=A
    d.append(np.einsum('bii->bi',Ak))
    for k in range(5):

    d1,d2,d3,d4,d5,d6=[a.sum(1) for a in d]
    fp=iv("fp",d1)
    t2=iv("t2",(d2-d1)/2)
    long=iv("long",(((d3-d2)/3+(d4-d2)/4+(d5-d1)/5+(d6-d3-(d2-d1))/6)>0).astype(float))
    h1=(t2>0).astype(float); h0=(fp>0).astype(float); c0=h0*(1-long)
    s0=2*c0*(1-h1); s1=3*h1; s2=(1-h1)*(1-c0)
    z=0*s2
    return np.stack([s0,s1,s2,z,z-1,z-2],1)
ALIGN={"tok%d"%p:["embed"] for p in range(6)}
'''

```python
def model(x,iv):
```
```
    h=np.arange(6.)
```
```python
    T=np.stack([iv("tok%d"%p,(x[:,p][:,None]==h)*1.).argmax(1) for p in range(6)],1)
    fix=T==h

    fp=iv("fp",fix.sum(1)*1.)
    A=np.zeros((len(T),6,6)); A[np.arange(len(T))[:,None],h.astype(int)[None,:],T]=1.
    d=[]; Ak=A
    for k in range(6):
        d.append(np.einsum('bii->b',Ak)); Ak=Ak@A
    d1,d2,d3,d4,d5,d6=d
    t2=iv("t2",((d2-d1)/2).round())
    L=iv("long",(((d3-d2)/3+(d4-d2)/4+(d5-d1)/5+(d6-d3-(d2-d1))/6)>0.5)*1.)
```
```python
    v=T[:,5]; fv=np.take_along_axis(T,v[:,None],1)[:,0]; ff=np.take_along_axis(T,fv[:,None],1)[:,0]

    c0=C*1.
    s0=2*c0*(1-h1); s1=3*h1; s2=(1-h1)*(1-c0); z=0*s2
```
